bednovel.com: The legacy crawler stops after one page of the chapter list. Measured 2026-08-11 on the recorded novel: it reads 40 chapters where the spec reads 1854, ending at 'Chapter 40' against the spec's 'Chapter 1854 - 779: Treasure For Upgrading'.
creativenovels.com: The crawler appends the site's own name to the novel's: 'Substitute Hero - Creative Novels' where the spec reads 'Substitute Hero'. It prefixes the author the same way, 'Author:Fushigi'. Measured 2026-08-09 on the recorded novel.
freewebnovel.com: The legacy crawler stops partway through the list. Measured 2026-08-11 on the recorded novel: it ends at 'Chapter 120' where the spec ends at 'Chapter 208: Mountain, Sea Xiv - Final Iii', which is the last chapter the site's own pager reaches.
hostednovel.com: The site ends every chapter list with one advert per membership tier, worded and linked like a chapter — 'Chapter 2210 - 2230 Gold (40 chapters)' — whose page is marked '(Teaser)' and carries no prose. The legacy crawler keeps them and finishes a book with a run of empty chapters. Measured 2026-08-09: 19 such rows on chaotic-sword-god and 9 on apocalypse-gacha, so the spec reads 4017 where the crawler reads 4036. The crawler also keeps the row's bullet and its relative date, titling the first chapter '•Chapter 1: Jian Chen6 Years 2 Months Ago6 Years 2 Months Ago'.
kolnovel.com: The legacy crawler counts anchors, and every row on this theme carries two: the chapter and an `a.dlpdf` beside it linking the same chapter's PDF. It reads 170 chapters where 85 exist, half of them PDF URLs titled 'Chapter N'. Measured 2026-08-09 on the recorded novel: 85 `.eplister li` rows, 170 anchors, 170 distinct hrefs.
libread.com: The same one-page stop as bednovel. Measured 2026-08-11: 40 chapters against the spec's 797.
lnmtl.com: The novel is titled in both languages the site knows it by, 'Apocalypse Summoner 末世之黑暗召唤师'. The legacy crawler reads the first word of it, 'Apocalypse'. Measured 2026-08-11 on the recorded novel.
novelcool.com: The chapter list ends with a link to the novel's comment thread, worded and shaped like a chapter. The legacy crawler keeps it and reads 190 where 189 exist; the spec drops it on the address. Measured 2026-08-11 on the recorded novel.
ontimestory.eu: Both tiers strip the novel's name from each chapter title; the crawler strips the wrong amount. It leaves 'In The Face Of Melodrama – Chapter 1' on a novel called 'A Love-Struck Brain Is Nothing In The Face Of Melodrama', having cut four words and kept the rest of the name. The spec cuts at the theme's own separator and reads 'Chapter 1'. Measured 2026-08-09 on the recorded novel.
skynovels.net: Chapter titles differ by the site's own prefix. The API's `chp_index_title`, which is the only title on the flat chapter list, carries the novel's acronym — 'SG - Capitulo 1' — where the legacy crawler reads a title without it. The count and the order agree. Measured 2026-08-11 on the recorded novel.
smnovels.com: The legacy crawler stops after one page. It reads 100 chapters in 1 volume where the spec reads 5401 in 55, ending at 'Chapter: 5404 (End)' against the crawler's 'Chapter : 100'. Measured 2026-08-09 on the recorded novel.
wuxiabox.com: The legacy side is the unstable one. Both tiers read 1333 chapters, but the legacy crawler's order varies between runs when it follows another crawl of the same host: three consecutive diffs on 2026-08-09 ended at chapter 1238, 1202 and 1089, and a fourth matched. Run alone it is stable. The spec's order was checked against the site: the pager's last page carries 33 rows ending at 1238, which is what the spec reports every time.
